subject.title: Slack: Include file attachment metadata in inbound message delivery to agents

question: What shared inbound attachment metadata contract should agents receive for Slack, Discord, Telegram, and future channel plugins?
rationale: The remaining work changes the channel-to-agent context contract and privacy boundary; automation should not choose between a shared API, a Slack-only stopgap, or keeping the current placeholder/download-file workflow.

options.title: Design shared metadata
options.body: Add a cross-channel attachment metadata field with stable names and privacy rules, then implement Slack as the first mapper.

options.title: Use a Slack-only stopgap
options.body: Expose only Slack file metadata now, accepting a likely migration when other channel plugins need the same shape.

options.title: Keep current placeholders
options.body: Keep fileId placeholders plus download-file as the supported workflow and close this request after maintainer confirmation.

recommendation.title: Design shared metadata
recommendation.body: Add a cross-channel attachment metadata field with stable names and privacy rules, then implement Slack as the first mapper.

likelyOwner.reason: They are already in the issue discussion and have nearby Slack media auth/download history, making them a good first routing owner for the API decision.
